content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides a single verse Matthew 1:16 as underdetermined from its own grammar instead of weighing the parties' chains by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the passive egennēthē (was born) with feminine hēs (of whom) admits both the withheld-father and the birth-narration readings","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"none","why":"It uses a single verse's open grammar to leave the link underdetermined, contrary to K-C's requirement to weigh chain against chain by footing rather than verse by verse."}
